### When You Report a Death

- If you are getting benefits on your spouse's or parent's record:
  - You generally will not need to file an application for survivors benefits.
  - We'll automatically change any monthly benefits you receive to survivors benefits after we receive the report of death.
  - We may be able to pay the Special Lump-Sum Death Payment automatically.
- If you are getting retirement or disability benefits on your own record:
  - You will need to apply for the survivors benefits.
  - We will check to see whether you can get a higher benefit as a widow or widower.
- If you are not getting benefits, you should apply for survivors benefits promptly because, in some cases, benefits may not be retroactive.

### Documents Needed to Apply

Please select the benefit you will be applying for from the list below to see what information and documents you may need when you apply:

- Widows/Widowers or Surviving Divorced Spouse's Benefits
- Child's Benefits
- Mother's or Father's Benefits (You must have a child under age 16 or disabled in your care.)
- Lump-Sum Death Payment
- Parent's Benefits (You must have been dependent on your child at the time of his or her death.)

If you don't have all the documents you need, don't delay applying for Social Security.

您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上 ，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

## Benefits Planner: Retirement

### Benefits For Your Spouse

Even if you have never worked under Social Security, you may be able to get spouse s retirement benefits if you are at least 62 years of age and your spouse is receiving retirement or disability benefits. You can also qualify for Medicare at age 65.

If you are divorced, you may still be able to get benefits on your ex-spouse's record. For information on the requirements for Divorced Spouse's Benefits, read "If You Are Divorced

You can receive the spouse's benefit no matter what your age is if you are caring for their child who is also receiving benefits.

### How Much Will I Receive?

If you qualify and apply for your own retirement benefits and for benefits as a spouse, we always pay your own benefits first. If your benefits as a spouse are higher than your own retirement benefits, you will get a combination of benefits equaling the higher spouse benefit.

Your benefits as a spouse do not include any delayed retirement credits your spouse may receive.

If you begin receiving benefits:

- between age 62 and your full retirement age, the amount will be permanently reduced by a percentage based on the number of months up to your full retirement age.

 

- If you are under full retirement age and you continue to work while receiving benefits, your benefits may be affected by the retirement earnings test.

- at your full retirement age, your benefit as a spouse cannot exceed one-half of your spouse's full retirement amount.

 

- If you were born before January 2, 1954 and have already reached full retirement age, you can choose to receive only the spouse s benefit and delay receiving your retirement benefit until a later date. If your spouse is full retirement age and applying for spouse s benefits only, they can apply online by using the retirement application. Your spouse can also contact us to schedule an appointment.

If your spouse s birthday is January 2, 1954 or later, the option to take only one benefit at full retirement age no longer exists. If your spouse files for one benefit, they will be effectively filing for all retirement or spousal benefits.

If you will receive a pension for work not covered by Social Security such as government employment, the amount of your Social Security benefits on your spouse's record may be reduced.

Benefits paid to you as a spouse will not decrease your spouse s retirement benefit. In fact, the value of the benefits you may receive, added to their benefits, may help your spouse decide if taking benefits sooner may be more advantageous.

#### Maximum Family Benefits

If one of your spouse's children also qualifies for benefits, there is a limit to the amount we can pay family members.

The total depends on your spouse's benefit amount and the number of family members who also qualify on the same record. The total varies, but generally the total amount the worker (your spouse) and their family members can receive is about 150 to 180 percent of the worker's full retirement benefit.

If there is an ex-spouse who also qualifies for benefits, they will not affect the total amount of benefits you or your family may receive.

### How Do I Apply?

You can apply:

- Online - Use our Social Security Retirement/Medicare Benefit Application to apply for retirement, spouse's, divorced spouse's or Medicare benefits.

 

- If your spouse is already receiving benefits when you apply, or if you and your spouse apply at the same time, we will also check your eligibility for benefits as a spouse. If you qualify, your application will automatically serve as a request for spousal benefits.

- By phone - Call us at 1-800-772-1213. If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can call us at TTY 1-800-325-0778.

 

- In person - Visit your local Social Security office. (Call first to make an appointment.)

- If you do not live in the U.S. or one of its territories you can also - Contact the nearest U.S. Social Security office, U.S. Embassy or consulate.

### Next Steps

Even if you do not qualify for benefits on someone else's record, some members of your family may qualify for benefits on your record. If you:

- are interested in information about benefits for your family, go to "Benefits For Your Family."

Just as you plan for your family's protection if you die, you should consider the Social Security benefits that may be available if you are the survivor that is, the spouse, child, or parent of a worker who dies. That person must have worked long enough under Social Security to qualify for benefits.

A worker can earn up to four credits each year. In 2019, for example, your spouse can earn one credit for each $1,360 of wages or self-employment income. When your spouse has earned $5,440, they have earned their four credits for the year.

The number of credits needed to provide benefits for survivors depends on the worker's age when they die. No one needs more than 40 credits (10 years of work) to be eligible for any Social Security benefit. But, the younger a person is, the fewer credits they must have for family members to receive survivors benefits.

Benefits can be paid to the worker's children and the surviving spouse who is caring for the children even if the worker doesn't have the required number of credits. They can get benefits if the worker has credit for one and one-half years of work (6 credits) in the three years just before their death. Each person s situation is different and you need to talk to a Social Security claims representative about your choices.

We should be notified as soon as possible when a person dies. However, you cannot report a death or apply for survivors benefits online.

In most cases, the funeral home will report the person s death to us. You should give the funeral home the deceased person s Social Security number if you want them to make the report.

## Multiple party or contested claims

If you re one of multiple people claiming the right to the same benefit, you have 60 days to appeal to a Veterans Law Judge at the Board of Veterans Appeals in Washington, D.C. A judge who s an expert in Veterans law will review your case.

## Mark your calendar

You have 60 days from the date on your decision to request a Board Appeal.

## Can I add new evidence?

You have the option to add new evidence for a judge to review. You ll have to submit this evidence within 90 days from the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.

This option will take longer.

## Can I request a hearing?

You have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.

This option will take longer.

## What happens at a hearing?

You and the judge will have a conversation. The judge will listen to your testimony. The judge may ask you a few questions. Your representative, if you have one, may help you at the hearing.

The hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.

Direct Review If you want a Veterans Law Judge to review your case as quickly as possible, choose a Direct Review.

You can t submit any evidence.

Evidence Submission If you have additional evidence for a Veterans Law Judge to review, choose Evidence Submission.

If you were recently denied Social Security benefits or Supplemental Security Income (SSI), you may request an appeal. Generally, you have 60 days after you receive the notice of our decision to ask for any type of appeal. There are four levels of appeal:

- Reconsideration,
- Hearing by an administrative law judge,
- Review by the Appeals Council, and
- Federal Court review (Please see the bottom of page for information on the Federal Court Review Process).

You can request an appeal online for a reconsideration, a hearing by an administrative law judge, and a review by the Appeals Council, even if you live outside of the United States. When we made the first determination on your claim, we sent you a letter explaining our determination. This letter contains guidance on what level of appeal you should select.

To learn more about each appeal level, visit Information About Social Security's Hearings and Appeals Process.

Reconsideration

### Request a Reconsideration Online for a Medical Determination

If your disability claim was recently denied for medical reasons, you can request an appeal online.

A reconsideration is a complete review of your claim by someone who did not take part in the first determination. We will look at all the evidence submitted used in the original determination, plus any new evidence.

Request Medical Reconsideration Continue Request for Medical Reconsideration You Started

### Request a Reconsideration Online for a Non-Medical Determination

If you received a non-medical determination letter from us that you disagree with or you were denied for a reason that is not disability related (for example: income, resources, overpayments, living arrangements), you can request a non-medical appeal online.

Request Non-Medical Reconsideration

### Check the Status of Your Reconsideration

Whether you applied online, by phone, or in an office, you can check the status of your disability and SSI Reconsideration using your personal my Social Security account. A my Social Security account is an easy, convenient, and secure way to do business with us. If you don t have one, you can create one today.

Sign In or Create Account

Hearing by an Administrative Law Judge

### Request a Hearing for a Medical Determination Online

A hearing is conducted by an administrative law judge who had no part in the original determination or the reconsideration of your case. The hearing is usually held within 75 miles of your home. If you disagree with the determination we made at the reconsideration level, you may request a hearing online.

Request Medical Hearing Continue Medical Hearing Request You Started

### Request a Hearing for a Non-Medical Determination Online

If you requested a reconsideration and received a non-medical determination letter from us that you disagree with or you were denied benefits for a reason that is not disability related (for example: income, resources, overpayments, living arrangements), you can request a non-medical hearing online.

Request Non-Medical Hearing

### Check the Status of Your Hearing

Whether you applied online, by phone, or in an office, you can check the status of your disability and SSI hearing using your personal my Social Security account. A my Social Security account is an easy, convenient, and secure way to do business with us. If you don t have one, you can create one today.

Sign In or Create Account

Request for Review by the Appeals Council

### Request an Appeals Council review of a decision or dismissal made by an administrative law judge

The Appeals Council looks at all requests for review, but it may deny a request if it believes the hearing decision was supported and in accordance with social security law and regulations. If the Appeals Council decides to review your case, it will either decide your case itself or return it to an administrative law judge for further review. If you disagree with the hearing decision, you may request a review by Social Security s Appeals Council online.

Request Appeals Council Review

Federal Court review

If you disagree with the Appeals Council's decision, or if the Appeals Council decides not to review your case, you can file a civil suit in a federal district court. This is the last level of the appeals process. Currently, this process is not available online. To learn more about this process, visit Federal Court Review Process.

## Multiple party or contested claims

If you re one of multiple people claiming the right to the same benefit, you have 60 days to appeal to a Veterans Law Judge at the Board of Veterans Appeals in Washington, D.C. A judge who s an expert in Veterans law will review your case.

## Mark your calendar

You have 60 days from the date on your decision to request a Board Appeal.

## Can I add new evidence?

You have the option to add new evidence for a judge to review. You ll have to submit this evidence within 90 days from the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.

This option will take longer.

## Can I request a hearing?

You have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.

This option will take longer.

## What happens at a hearing?

You and the judge will have a conversation. The judge will listen to your testimony. The judge may ask you a few questions. Your representative, if you have one, may help you at the hearing.

The hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.

## How do I request a Board Appeal?

To request a Board Appeal, fill out the Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182). Download VA Form 10182 (PDF)

### Choose one of the 3 options to appeal with a Veterans Law Judge

Direct Review If you want a Veterans Law Judge to review your case as quickly as possible, choose a Direct Review.

You can t submit any evidence.

About 1 year The Board s goal for deciding appeals with no new evidence and no hearing is about a year.

Evidence Submission If you have additional evidence for a Veterans Law Judge to review, choose Evidence Submission.

You must submit evidence within 90 days of the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.

Longer If you add new evidence, it ll take longer than the Direct Review appeal option.

Hearing Request If you want a video conference hearing with a Veterans Law Judge at a nearby VA location, choose a Hearing Request.

At your hearing, you and a Veterans Law Judge will have a conversation, and they ll ask you questions about your appeal. Your hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. Learn more about hearings and how to request one

You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.

Longer If you request a hearing, it ll take longer than the Direct Review appeal option.

### List the issue(s) you want to appeal in Part III

You can include all or just some of the issues VA has decided. You ll need to list the issue(s) you disagree with and the VA decision date for each.

### Apply

## Send the completed form and any supporting documents to this address:

Fax your completed form to 844-678-8979.

## After a Board decision

If you disagree with the Board s decision, you can appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. You can hire an attorney to represent you, or you can represent yourself. Learn more about filing a Court Appeal

If you were recently denied Social Security benefits or Supplemental Security Income (SSI), you may request an appeal. Generally, you have 60 days after you receive the notice of our decision to ask for any type of appeal. There are four levels of appeal:

- Reconsideration,
- Hearing by an administrative law judge,
- Review by the Appeals Council, and
- Federal Court review (Please see the bottom of page for information on the Federal Court Review Process).

You can request an appeal online for a reconsideration, a hearing by an administrative law judge, and a review by the Appeals Council, even if you live outside of the United States. When we made the first determination on your claim, we sent you a letter explaining our determination. This letter contains guidance on what level of appeal you should select.

To learn more about each appeal level, visit Information About Social Security's Hearings and Appeals Process.

Reconsideration

### Request a Reconsideration Online for a Medical Determination

If your disability claim was recently denied for medical reasons, you can request an appeal online.

A reconsideration is a complete review of your claim by someone who did not take part in the first determination. We will look at all the evidence submitted used in the original determination, plus any new evidence.

Request Medical Reconsideration Continue Request for Medical Reconsideration You Started

### Request a Reconsideration Online for a Non-Medical Determination

If you received a non-medical determination letter from us that you disagree with or you were denied for a reason that is not disability related (for example: income, resources, overpayments, living arrangements), you can request a non-medical appeal online.

Request Non-Medical Reconsideration

### Check the Status of Your Reconsideration

Whether you applied online, by phone, or in an office, you can check the status of your disability and SSI Reconsideration using your personal my Social Security account. A my Social Security account is an easy, convenient, and secure way to do business with us. If you don t have one, you can create one today.

Sign In or Create Account

Hearing by an Administrative Law Judge

### Request a Hearing for a Medical Determination Online

A hearing is conducted by an administrative law judge who had no part in the original determination or the reconsideration of your case. The hearing is usually held within 75 miles of your home. If you disagree with the determination we made at the reconsideration level, you may request a hearing online.

Request Medical Hearing Continue Medical Hearing Request You Started

### Request a Hearing for a Non-Medical Determination Online

If you requested a reconsideration and received a non-medical determination letter from us that you disagree with or you were denied benefits for a reason that is not disability related (for example: income, resources, overpayments, living arrangements), you can request a non-medical hearing online.

Request Non-Medical Hearing

### Check the Status of Your Hearing

Whether you applied online, by phone, or in an office, you can check the status of your disability and SSI hearing using your personal my Social Security account. A my Social Security account is an easy, convenient, and secure way to do business with us. If you don t have one, you can create one today.

Sign In or Create Account

Request for Review by the Appeals Council

### Request an Appeals Council review of a decision or dismissal made by an administrative law judge

The Appeals Council looks at all requests for review, but it may deny a request if it believes the hearing decision was supported and in accordance with social security law and regulations. If the Appeals Council decides to review your case, it will either decide your case itself or return it to an administrative law judge for further review. If you disagree with the hearing decision, you may request a review by Social Security s Appeals Council online.

Request Appeals Council Review

Federal Court review

If you disagree with the Appeals Council's decision, or if the Appeals Council decides not to review your case, you can file a civil suit in a federal district court. This is the last level of the appeals process. Currently, this process is not available online. To learn more about this process, visit Federal Court Review Process.

## Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

With Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI), you may be able to keep your life insurance coverage after you leave the military for as long as you continue to pay the premiums. Find out if you qualify for VGLI and how to manage your coverage.

You may be able to get VGLI if you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.

## At least one of these must be true. You:

Had part-time Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI) as a member of the National Guard or Reserves, and you suffered an injury or disability (damage to your body or mind that makes it hard for you to do everyday tasks, including meaningful work) while on duty including direct traveling to and from duty that disqualified you for standard premium insurance rates, or Had SGLI while you were in the military and you re within 1 year and 120 days of being released from an active-duty period of 31 or more days, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of retiring or being released from the Ready Reserves or National Guard, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of assignment to the Individual Ready Reserves (IRR) of a branch of service, or to the Inactive National Guard (ING). This includes members of the United States Public Health Service Inactive Reserve Corps (IRC), or Are within 1 year and 120 days of being put on the Temporary Disability Retirement List (TDRL)

## Who s covered?

## Veterans Former service members

## What life insurance benefits can I get with VGLI?

$10,000 to $400,000 in life insurance benefits, based on the amount of SGLI coverage you had when you left the military.

Note: When you leave the military, you can sign up through VGLI for coverage up to the amount you had through SGLI. You can also increase your coverage by $25,000 every 5 years up to $400,000 until you re 60 years old.

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to apply for VGLI within one year and 120 days of leaving the military.

If you sign up within 240 days of leaving the military, you won t need to prove you re in good health. If you sign up after the 240-day period, you ll need to submit evidence that you re in good health.

## Apply in one of these ways:

Apply through the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI), using the Prudential website. Apply online through OSGLI Apply online through eBenefits Apply by mail or fax. Fill out the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (SGLV 8714). Download the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

To reinstate a VGLI policy that has expired, you ll need to fill out an Application for Reinstatement of VGLI Coverage (SGLV 180). Download SGLV 180 (PDF)

## How much will I pay for these benefits?

VGLI premium rates are based on your age and the amount of insurance coverage you want.

Choose your age to find monthly premium rates as of July 1, 2014.

## Can I choose or update my beneficiaries?

Yes. You can choose your beneficiaries (the people you pick to get the money from your life insurance policy if you die) and change them as needed.

## Update your beneficiary information in one of these ways:

Access your policy online. Find your policy through Prudential Life Insurance Company of America, or Fill out a VGLI Beneficiary Designation form (SGLV 8721). Download SGLV 8721 (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

## Can I convert my VGLI policy into a commercial policy?

Yes. You can convert your policy into a commercial (civilian) policy at any time. You ll be able to convert at standard premium rates, without having to provide proof that you re in good health.

## To convert your VGLI policy:

## Choose your new insurance company.View our list of companies that take part in this program (PDF)

Apply at the local sales office of your chosen company.

Get a letter from OSGLI confirming that you have VGLI coverage (called a VGLI Conversion Notice) and give the letter to the agent who takes your application.

Note: The conversion policy must be a permanent policy, such as a whole life policy. You can t convert to other types of policies, like term, variable life, or universal life insurance. And supplementary policy benefits, like Accidental Death and Dismemberment or Waiver of Premium for Disability, aren t considered part of the conversion policy.

## What if I need help with my claim?

If you have questions about Servicemembers or Veterans Group Life Insurance, you can call the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI) at 800-419-1473 or email the Prudential Insurance Company.

## Which forms would my family member need?

To request an advance insurance payment for a service member who s terminally ill, a family member would file a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284).Download SGLV 8284 (PDF) To receive an insurance payment in their time of need, a family member would file a Claim for Death Benefits (SGLV 8283).Download SGLV 8283 (PDF)

### 当我离开军队时如何申请VGLI？

当您离开军队时，您可以在退伍后1年零120天内申请退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI），最高保额为您通过SGLI拥有的保险金额。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

您还可以在离开军队之日起120天内将您的SGLI保单转换为 civilian 保单。了解如何将您的SGLI保障转换为个人保单（PDF）

### 如果我离开军队时残疾，我可以免费延长我的SGLI保障吗？

如果您在离军日期后2年内，并且满足以下任一要求，您可能可以在离开军队之日起保留保障最多2年。

以下至少一项必须为真：

- 您在退伍时完全残疾且无法工作，或
- 无论您的工作状况如何，您已患有以下情况之一：
  - 双耳完全失聪
  - 丧失言语能力，即使借助人工设备也无法低声说话
  - 双手、双脚或双眼，或一只手和一只脚，或一只手或一只脚和一只眼睛永久（长期）丧失功能

### 我如何申请SGLI残疾延长？

您需要申请军人团体人寿保险残疾延长（SGLI-DE）。

要申请，请填写SGLI残疾延长申请表（SGLV 8715）并将其发送至申请表上列出的OSGLI地址。下载SGLV 8715（PDF）

如果您的申请获得批准，您将在离军日期后20个月收到通知，告知您的SGLI-DE即将结束，并且您现在可以选择支付保费以参加退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI）。

如果您支付保费，只要您持续支付保费，您就可以保留您的人寿保险保障。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

### 如果我的索赔需要帮助怎么办？

如果您对军人或退伍军人团体人寿保险有疑问，您可以拨打军人团体人寿保险办公室（OSGLI）电话800-419-1473，或发送电子邮件至保德信保险公司。

### 我的家人需要哪些表格？

- 要为患有绝症的军人申请预付保险金，家属需提交加速给付索赔表（SGLV 8284）。下载SGLV 8284（PDF）
- 要在需要时获得保险金，家属需提交死亡抚恤金索赔表（SGLV 8283）。下载SGLV 8283（PDF）
- 要帮助军人在创伤性损伤恢复期间获得短期经济支持，家属需与军人共同提交TSGLI福利申请表（SGLV 8600）。下载SGLV 8600（PDF）

## Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

With Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI), you may be able to keep your life insurance coverage after you leave the military for as long as you continue to pay the premiums. Find out if you qualify for VGLI and how to manage your coverage.

## Am I eligible for Veterans Group Life Insurance?

You may be able to get VGLI if you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.

## At least one of these must be true. You:

Had part-time Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI) as a member of the National Guard or Reserves, and you suffered an injury or disability (damage to your body or mind that makes it hard for you to do everyday tasks, including meaningful work) while on duty including direct traveling to and from duty that disqualified you for standard premium insurance rates, or Had SGLI while you were in the military and you re within 1 year and 120 days of being released from an active-duty period of 31 or more days, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of retiring or being released from the Ready Reserves or National Guard, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of assignment to the Individual Ready Reserves (IRR) of a branch of service, or to the Inactive National Guard (ING). This includes members of the United States Public Health Service Inactive Reserve Corps (IRC), or Are within 1 year and 120 days of being put on the Temporary Disability Retirement List (TDRL)

## Who s covered?

## Veterans Former service members

## What life insurance benefits can I get with VGLI?

$10,000 to $400,000 in life insurance benefits, based on the amount of SGLI coverage you had when you left the military.

Note: When you leave the military, you can sign up through VGLI for coverage up to the amount you had through SGLI. You can also increase your coverage by $25,000 every 5 years up to $400,000 until you re 60 years old.

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to apply for VGLI within one year and 120 days of leaving the military.

If you sign up within 240 days of leaving the military, you won t need to prove you re in good health. If you sign up after the 240-day period, you ll need to submit evidence that you re in good health.

## Apply in one of these ways:

Apply through the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI), using the Prudential website. Apply online through OSGLI Apply online through eBenefits Apply by mail or fax. Fill out the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (SGLV 8714). Download the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

To reinstate a VGLI policy that has expired, you ll need to fill out an Application for Reinstatement of VGLI Coverage (SGLV 180). Download SGLV 180 (PDF)

## How much will I pay for these benefits?

VGLI premium rates are based on your age and the amount of insurance coverage you want.

Choose your age to find monthly premium rates as of July 1, 2014.

## Can I choose or update my beneficiaries?

Yes. You can choose your beneficiaries (the people you pick to get the money from your life insurance policy if you die) and change them as needed.

## Update your beneficiary information in one of these ways:

Access your policy online. Find your policy through Prudential Life Insurance Company of America, or Fill out a VGLI Beneficiary Designation form (SGLV 8721). Download SGLV 8721 (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

## Can I convert my VGLI policy into a commercial policy?

Yes. You can convert your policy into a commercial (civilian) policy at any time. You ll be able to convert at standard premium rates, without having to provide proof that you re in good health.

## To convert your VGLI policy:

## Choose your new insurance company.View our list of companies that take part in this program (PDF)

Apply at the local sales office of your chosen company.

Get a letter from OSGLI confirming that you have VGLI coverage (called a VGLI Conversion Notice) and give the letter to the agent who takes your application.

Note: The conversion policy must be a permanent policy, such as a whole life policy. You can t convert to other types of policies, like term, variable life, or universal life insurance. And supplementary policy benefits, like Accidental Death and Dismemberment or Waiver of Premium for Disability, aren t considered part of the conversion policy.

## What if I need help with my claim?

If you have questions about Servicemembers or Veterans Group Life Insurance, you can call the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI) at 800-419-1473 or email the Prudential Insurance Company.

## Which forms would my family member need?

To request an advance insurance payment for a service member who s terminally ill, a family member would file a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284).Download SGLV 8284 (PDF) To receive an insurance payment in their time of need, a family member would file a Claim for Death Benefits (SGLV 8283).Download SGLV 8283 (PDF)

### 我收到了DMV的保险“信函”或“命令”。我能做什么？

仔细阅读信函或命令（参见示例 [1]），迅速回复，并立即联系您的保险公司。如果有问题，您有责任解决。如果您不这样做，DMV可能会暂停您的车辆注册和驾驶执照。

#### 不要

- 如果您的保险被取消，即使您认为这是个错误，也不要使用您的车辆
- 在您与保险公司解决问题时，不要保留车牌 1

#### 要

- 在您的保险覆盖结束前，交出您的车辆注册和车牌 [2]

### 我如何回复信函或命令？

您的回复必须

- 证明您有保险覆盖
- 证明您出售了车辆
- 证明不需要保险覆盖

如果您有保险覆盖，也请您的保险公司（不要问您的代理人或经纪人）向DMV电子提交保险覆盖通知。 2

### 如果我没有责任保险，我必须做什么？

如果您没有保险，或者保险即将到期且您不打算更换，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车牌 [2]。 3

### 我收到一封说明我的保险失效的信。我能做什么？

这封信意味着您的保险公司通知DMV您的保险覆盖已结束，并且没有其他公司通知DMV关于新的覆盖。

如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并联系您的公司或代理人解决问题。请您的公司向DMV电子提交覆盖通知。

如果您没有保险，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车辆注册和车牌。

### 我收到一封说明我的驾照被暂停的信。我能做什么？

这封信意味着您的保险公司已通知DMV您的保险保障已终止，且没有其他公司就新保障通知DMV。

如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并就问题联系您的公司或代理人。请您的公司以电子方式向DMV提交保障通知。

如果您没有保险，您需要立即将车辆登记和车牌交还给DMV。

当保障中断达到91天或以上，或中断期间尚未确定时，驾驶执照将被吊销。要确定中断期间，

- 车牌必须交还，或
- 车牌必须报告为丢失/被盗/被没收，或
- 登记必须到期，或
- 车牌必须由DMV转移到另一辆车，或
- DMV必须收到新的或恢复的保险证明，或
- DMV必须收到其他可接受的证明

一旦中断期间确定，登记将被暂停，如果中断期间为91天或以上，您的驾驶执照也将被暂停相同天数。暂停可能不在同一日期生效。因此，您可能先执行驾驶执照的暂停，或先执行登记的暂停。驾驶执照的暂停不会结束，直到您支付暂停终止费[3]并执行完暂停。

### I received a suspension order for an unsatisfied judgment related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash. What do I need to do?

To remove a suspension related to an unsatisfied judgment, you must resolve the judgment.

If you were notified that there is an unsatisfied judgment suspension on your record you must contact the attorney or court that issued the judgment. The information on the suspension order will advise you of the name of the court and the court index number for the judgment. The DMV cannot clear the suspension without proof from the court. Once you receive the original documentation from the court or attorney, you must send the original documents to DMV for clearance.

If you do not know which court to contact, you can call the NY State DMV Insurance Services Bureau. See Contact us [1].

### How do I get an unsatisfied judgment against another motorist?

To get an unsatisfied judgment against a motorist as a result of a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash, you must file a Supporting Affirmation (PDF) [2] (SR-60) and the other documents listed on the affirmation (SR-60).

### Will the DMV suspend the driver license and all of the registrations of a person who has an unsatisfied judgment against them?

Yes. The DMV will suspend the license and registrations if the person fails to pay or satisfy a judgment of more than $1,000 and the judgment is related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash which causes property damage, bodily injury or death.

The DMV will also suspend

- all vehicle registrations of the company
- the privilege to register another vehicle"}, {"chunk_id": "Suspensions and revocations#3_0::c0000", "text": "[暂停与吊销 > 驾驶特权暂停]

### 我收到了DMV的保险“信函”或“命令”。我能做什么？

仔细阅读信函或命令（参见示例 [1]），迅速回复，并立即联系您的保险公司。如果有问题，您有责任解决。如果您不这样做，DMV可能会暂停您的车辆注册和驾驶执照。

#### 不要

- 如果您的保险被取消，即使您认为这是个错误，也不要使用您的车辆
- 在您与保险公司解决问题时，不要保留车牌 1

#### 要

- 在您的保险覆盖结束前，交出您的车辆注册和车牌 [2]

### 我如何回复信函或命令？

您的回复必须

- 证明您有保险覆盖
- 证明您出售了车辆
- 证明不需要保险覆盖

如果您有保险覆盖，也请您的保险公司（不要问您的代理人或经纪人）向DMV电子提交保险覆盖通知。 2

### 如果我没有责任保险，我必须做什么？

如果您没有保险，或者保险即将到期且您不打算更换，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车牌 [2]。 3

### 我收到一封说明我的保险失效的信。我能做什么？

这封信意味着您的保险公司通知DMV您的保险覆盖已结束，并且没有其他公司通知DMV关于新的覆盖。

如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并联系您的公司或代理人解决问题。请您的公司向DMV电子提交覆盖通知。

如果您没有保险，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车辆注册和车牌。

### 我收到一封说明我的驾照被暂停的信。我能做什么？

这封信意味着您的保险公司已通知DMV您的保险保障已终止，且没有其他公司就新保障通知DMV。

如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并就问题联系您的公司或代理人。请您的公司以电子方式向DMV提交保障通知。

如果您没有保险，您需要立即将车辆登记和车牌交还给DMV。

当保障中断达到91天或以上，或中断期间尚未确定时，驾驶执照将被吊销。要确定中断期间，

- 车牌必须交还，或
- 车牌必须报告为丢失/被盗/被没收，或
- 登记必须到期，或
- 车牌必须由DMV转移到另一辆车，或
- DMV必须收到新的或恢复的保险证明，或
- DMV必须收到其他可接受的证明

### I received a suspension order for an unsatisfied judgment related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash. What do I need to do?

To remove a suspension related to an unsatisfied judgment, you must resolve the judgment.

If you were notified that there is an unsatisfied judgment suspension on your record you must contact the attorney or court that issued the judgment. The information on the suspension order will advise you of the name of the court and the court index number for the judgment. The DMV cannot clear the suspension without proof from the court. Once you receive the original documentation from the court or attorney, you must send the original documents to DMV for clearance.

### What is a DIAL-IN search account and who can get one?

If you regularly need to search DMV records for driver license, registration, vehicle (title) or insurance information, then DIAL-IN is the service you need. Our typical clients include attorneys, insurance and private investigators, process servers and building/site security personnel.

See Drivers Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) [2] for more information about permissible uses of DMV records.

### How do I apply for an account?

You should complete form Motor Vehicle Record Search Account Application (PDF) [3] (MV-15D). The instructions are on the form.

Send the form to:

Data Services - New Search AccountNYS Department of Motor Vehicles6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

### How will I know my application has been accepted?

We will review your application. If you application is not complete, we will return your application with an explanation that will give you more instructions.

If your application is complete, we will create an account for you. We will send you your account number and password. Your seven-digit account number will never change. You will enter this account number when you log in to the DIAL-IN system.

### Are there fees for using a DIAL-IN search account?

According to the NYS Vehicle and Traffic Law, we must charge a fee to search DMV records. Private persons, commercial organizations, and not-for-profit organizations must pay a search fee. There is a fee of $7.00 for each search that you make with the DIAL-IN service.

There are some organizations that are exempt from search fees. Any public organization, its officers, a volunteer fire company, a volunteer ambulance service, or a legal aid bureau or society or other private entity acting pursuant to section 722 of the New York State County Law, that makes a search for a public purpose, is exempt from the search fee.

### How do I pay DIAL-IN Search Account fees?

Paying customers must include a deposit with the application. Your first deposit must be enough to pay for two months of searches. When we accept your application, your deposit is added to your new account balance. When you make a search, we subtract the search fee from your account balance.

Payment by credit card is NOT available at this time.

You can use your account to pay for the mail-order searches and the online searches. If you must pay a fee for the service, your account records will reflect your debits and your credits and show your account balance. For more information, please visit our Escrow Accounts [4] page.

### What business records must I keep to document the searches I perform?

The business records you keep must exist prior to the search you perform and must establish the business purpose of the search.

Common examples of business records include invoices, retainer agreements, employment applications, consent forms, accident reports, and surveillance reports and numerous other types of records. The Terms of Service of your Search Account require you to maintain these records and to provide them to DMV when requested.

### Will DMV contact me about the searches I perform using my DIAL-IN Search Account?

Yes, DMV may ask you about a DIAL-IN search you performed. We inquire about searches to monitor compliance with the DIAL-IN Terms of Service.You must respond to the inquiry whether or not you have business records that support your search. Your response will be considered an incomplete reply if you do not give us the business records. You can complete an inquiry at any time if you send us the requested acceptable business records. If you performed the search on behalf of a client, you will need to show permissible use of your client, and your client agent relationship. If you personally did not perform the search we have inquired about, please check with the other users of your DIAL-IN account to see if one of them performed the search. If none of the known users performed the search, contact us immediately.If you do not respond to our inquiry about a DIAL-IN search, your search privileges will be suspended until you respond.

### Will you tell a motorist if I searched his records?

Yes. Records of searches are public records. If a motorist asks the DMV if his records were searched, the DMV supplies him with

- the name and business address of the DIAL-IN account holder, and
- the time, date and search criteria used to search for the records.

We do not disclose the DIAL-IN account numbers of the account holder that performed the search.

### How do I contact DMV about my Dial-in Search Account?

Log On to DIAL-IN [1]

### What is a DIAL-IN search account and who can get one?

If you regularly need to search DMV records for driver license, registration, vehicle (title) or insurance information, then DIAL-IN is the service you need. Our typical clients include attorneys, insurance and private investigators, process servers and building/site security personnel.

See Drivers Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) [2] for more information about permissible uses of DMV records.

### How do I apply for an account?

You should complete form Motor Vehicle Record Search Account Application (PDF) [3] (MV-15D). The instructions are on the form.

Send the form to:

Data Services - New Search AccountNYS Department of Motor Vehicles6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

### How will I know my application has been accepted?

We will review your application. If you application is not complete, we will return your application with an explanation that will give you more instructions.

If your application is complete, we will create an account for you. We will send you your account number and password. Your seven-digit account number will never change. You will enter this account number when you log in to the DIAL-IN system.

### Are there fees for using a DIAL-IN search account?

According to the NYS Vehicle and Traffic Law, we must charge a fee to search DMV records. Private persons, commercial organizations, and not-for-profit organizations must pay a search fee. There is a fee of $7.00 for each search that you make with the DIAL-IN service.

There are some organizations that are exempt from search fees. Any public organization, its officers, a volunteer fire company, a volunteer ambulance service, or a legal aid bureau or society or other private entity acting pursuant to section 722 of the New York State County Law, that makes a search for a public purpose, is exempt from the search fee.

### How do I pay DIAL-IN Search Account fees?

Paying customers must include a deposit with the application. Your first deposit must be enough to pay for two months of searches. When we accept your application, your deposit is added to your new account balance. When you make a search, we subtract the search fee from your account balance.

Payment by credit card is NOT available at this time.

You can use your account to pay for the mail-order searches and the online searches. If you must pay a fee for the service, your account records will reflect your debits and your credits and show your account balance. For more information, please visit our Escrow Accounts [4] page.

### What business records must I keep to document the searches I perform?

The business records you keep must exist prior to the search you perform and must establish the business purpose of the search.

Common examples of business records include invoices, retainer agreements, employment applications, consent forms, accident reports, and surveillance reports and numerous other types of records. The Terms of Service of your Search Account require you to maintain these records and to provide them to DMV when requested.

### Will DMV contact me about the searches I perform using my DIAL-IN Search Account?

Yes, DMV may ask you about a DIAL-IN search you performed. We inquire about searches to monitor compliance with the DIAL-IN Terms of Service.You must respond to the inquiry whether or not you have business records that support your search. Your response will be considered an incomplete reply if you do not give us the business records. You can complete an inquiry at any time if you send us the requested acceptable business records. If you performed the search on behalf of a client, you will need to show permissible use of your client, and your client agent relationship. If you personally did not perform the search we have inquired about, please check with the other users of your DIAL-IN account to see if one of them performed the search. If none of the known users performed the search, contact us immediately.If you do not respond to our inquiry about a DIAL-IN search, your search privileges will be suspended until you respond.

### Will you tell a motorist if I searched his records?

Yes. Records of searches are public records. If a motorist asks the DMV if his records were searched, the DMV supplies him with

- the name and business address of the DIAL-IN account holder, and
- the time, date and search criteria used to search for the records.

We do not disclose the DIAL-IN account numbers of the account holder that performed the search.

### How do I contact DMV about my Dial-in Search Account?

You can contact us at:NYSDMV DIAL-IN AccountsRoom 2316 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228(518) 473-2137e-mail: [email protected] [5]

### Note on browser compatibility

We are upgrading our security protocols to better protect your data. ### 家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您的子女之一**也符合资格**领取福利，我们能够支付给您家庭的金额有限制。总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也符合资格的家庭成员人数。

总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家人能收到的总金额约为您全额退休福利的150%至180%。

如果您有符合资格领取福利的离异配偶，这不会影响您或您的家人可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一同申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 配偶福利

您配偶的福利不包括您可能获得的任何延迟退休积分。

如果他们开始领取福利：

- 在62岁至其全额退休年龄之间，金额将根据距其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。如果您的配偶未达到全额退休年龄且：
  - 在领取福利期间工作，其福利可能受到退休收入测试的影响。
  - 也根据自身记录符合资格，其申请将包括两项福利。
- 在其全额退休年龄时，配偶的福利不能超过您全额退休金额的一半。"}, {"chunk_id": "Benefits Planner | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000", "text": "# 福利规划器 | 社会保障管理局

## 福利规划器：退休

### 您的家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

如果他们符合资格，您的配偶或子女每月可能收到高达您全额退休福利金额一半的付款。这些付款不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，您的家庭可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

支付给您配偶的福利不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，他们可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您有一位符合福利资格的前配偶，这不会影响您或您的家庭可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一起申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 您的配偶的福利

即使您的配偶从未在社会保障制度下工作过，只要他们年满62岁，并且您正在领取或有资格领取退休或残疾福利，他们也可能获得福利。您的配偶在65岁时也有资格加入Medicare。

### 我的配偶将收到多少？

如果您的配偶根据他们自己的记录有资格领取福利，我们将首先支付该金额。如果根据您的记录的福利更高，他们将根据您的记录获得额外金额，以便福利组合等于该更高金额。

我们的使命是提供满足公众不断变化需求的社会保障服务。

福利领取者的状况在申请或符合福利资格后发生变化并不罕见。如果您或您的家人领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI），某些生活变化可能会影响您获得联邦福利增加的资格。例如，如果您的配偶或前配偶去世，您可能有资格获得更高的社会保障福利。

要了解您或您的家人是否可能基于他人的工作记录而有资格获得福利，或基于您自己的工作记录获得更高的福利，请参阅社会保障网站上的福利信息。您还可以使用福利资格筛选工具（BEST）来了解您是否可以获得社会保障管理局管理的福利。根据您对问题的回答，该工具将列出您可能有资格获得的福利，并告诉您有关如何符合资格和申请的更多信息。

以下问题和答案涉及一些可能增加您福利的生活变化。

您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

如果您的配偶或前配偶已去世，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的遗属福利。即使您已经在领取基于另一位配偶的遗属福利，前配偶的去世也可能使您有资格获得更高的遗属福利。

您是否正在领取基于您自己工作记录的医疗保险福利，其中包括至少10年您缴纳社会保障税的收入？

如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

您那个曾帮助抚养您的成年子女是否已去世？

如果您的子女有足够的工作积分，并且曾提供您至少一半的生活费，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的父母福利。

您是否正在领取基于您配偶工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的退休福利。

您是否正在领取基于您父母工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的残疾福利。

您目前是否未婚，但曾结婚10年或以上？

如果您年满62岁且未婚，并且那段婚姻持续了10年或以上，您可能有资格基于前配偶的工作记录获得福利。

您的子女是否有资格根据您配偶的工作情况领取社会保障子女福利？

如果您照顾的子女未满16岁或在22岁之前残疾，您可能有资格领取配偶福利。

您目前是否正在领取退休或残疾福利，并且照顾的子女未满18岁或残疾？

您的子女可能根据您的工作情况有资格领取福利。

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI）或社会保障福利，并且有服兵役经历？

如果您曾在美国军队服役，您可能有资格通过退伍军人管理局领取福利。请访问此链接了解更多信息：http://www.va.gov/

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI），并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利？

如果您未婚且未满18岁或在22岁之前残疾，并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利，您可能有资格根据您父母的工作情况领取子女福利。

您的收入是否下降或您是否经历了财务资源的损失？

您可能能够通过补充保障收入计划获得额外收入，该计划帮助收入和财务资源有限的老年人和残疾人。

重要提示：如果您正在领取福利，有某些生活事件您必须报告。如需完整列表，请选择下方适用于您所领取福利类型的出版物。

注意：未能报告变更可能导致多付款项。

您或您的家人可能有资格获得增加的福利

我们的使命是提供满足公众不断变化需求的社会保障服务。

福利领取者的状况在申请或符合福利资格后发生变化并不罕见。如果您或您的家人领取社会保障或 补充保障收入（SSI），某些生活变化可能会影响您获得联邦福利增加的资格。例如，如果您的配 偶或前配偶去世，您可能有资格获得更高的社会保障福利。

要了解您或您的家人是否可能基于他人的工作记录而有资格获得福利，或基于您自己的工作记录获 得更高的福利，请参阅社会保障网站上的福利信息。您还可以使用福利资格筛选工具（BEST）来 了解您是否可以获得社会保障管理局管理的福利。根据您对问题的回答，该工具将列出您可能有资 格获得的福利，并告诉您有关如何符合资格和申请的更多信息。

以下问题和答案涉及一些可能增加您福利的生活变化。

您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

如果您的配偶或前配偶已去世，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的遗属福利。即使您 已经在领取基于另一位配偶的遗属福利，前配偶的去世也可能使您有资格获得更高的遗属福利。

您是否正在领取基于您自己工作记录的医疗保险福利，其中包括至少10年您缴纳社会保障税的收入 ？

如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上 ，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

您那个曾帮助抚养您的成年子女是否已去世？

如果您的子女有足够的工作积分，并且曾提供您至少一半的生活费，您可能有资格基于他或她的工 作记录获得更高的父母福利。

您是否正在领取基于您配偶工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的退休福利。

您是否正在领取基于您父母工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的残疾福利。

您目前是否未婚，但曾结婚10年或以上？

如果您年满62岁且未婚，并且那段婚姻持续了10年或以上，您可能有资格基于前配偶的工作记录获 得福利。

您的子女是否有资格根据您配偶的工作情况领取社会保障子女福利？

如果您照顾的子女未满16岁或在22岁之前残疾，您可能有资格领取配偶福利。

您目前是否正在领取退休或残疾福利，并且照顾的子女未满18岁或残疾？

您的子女可能根据您的工作情况有资格领取福利。

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI）或社会保障福利，并且有服兵役经历？

如果您曾在美国军队服役，您可能有资格通过退伍军人管理局领取福利。请访问此链接了解更多信 息：http://www.va.gov/

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI），并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利？

如果您未婚且未满18岁或在22岁之前残疾，并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利，您可 能有资格根据您父母的工作情况领取子女福利。

您的收入是否下降或您是否经历了财务资源的损失？

您可能能够通过补充保障收入计划获得额外收入，该计划帮助收入和财务资源有限的老年人和残疾 人。

## 福利规划器：家庭福利

当您开始领取残疾福利时，您的某些家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。福利可以支付给您的：

- 配偶；
- 离婚配偶；
- 子女；
- 残疾子女；以及
- 22岁前残疾的成年子女。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员申请福利，我们将要求提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

如果您的配偶申请福利，我们也可能要求提供婚姻证明以及之前婚姻的日期（如适用）。

### 最高家庭金额

每位家庭成员每月可能有资格领取高达您残疾福利金额50%的福利。但是，我们可以支付给您家庭的金额有限制。

总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也有资格领取福利的家庭成员人数。总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家庭可以领取的总金额在您残疾福利的150%到180%之间。

如果您的账户上应支付的福利总和大于家庭限额，则支付给家庭成员的福利将按比例减少。您的福利不会受到影响。

如果您有一位符合福利资格的离婚配偶，这不会影响您或您的家庭可能领取的福利金额。

### 您配偶的福利

当您的配偶有资格领取福利时：

- 年满62岁或以上，除非他或她根据其收入记录领取更高的社会保障福利。配偶福利金额将根据距离其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。

- 任何年龄，如果他或她在照顾您未满16岁或残疾的子女。

您的配偶将领取这些福利，直到子女年满16岁。届时，子女的福利继续，但您配偶的福利停止，除非他或她年龄足够领取退休福利（62岁或以上）或作为遗孀或鳏夫领取遗属福利（60岁）。

### 如果您的配偶也在社会保障下工作过

如果您的配偶有资格根据其自己的记录领取退休福利，我们将始终首先支付该金额。但是，如果根据您的记录应支付的配偶福利金额更高，他或她将获得等于该更高金额的福利组合。

如果您的配偶也将根据未纳入社会保障的工作（如政府或外国工作）领取养老金，那么他或她基于您记录获得的社会保障福利可能会受到影响。

### 您离婚配偶的福利

如果您已离婚，即使您再婚，您的前配偶也可能有资格基于您的记录获得福利。

（如果您的前配偶也将根据未纳入社会保障的工作（如政府或外国工作）领取养老金，那么他或她基于您记录获得的社会保障福利可能会受到影响。）

要基于您的记录获得资格，您的前配偶必须：

- 与您结婚至少10年；
- 年满62岁；
- 未婚；且
- 没有资格基于其自身或其他人的社会保障记录获得同等或更高的福利。

支付给您离婚配偶的福利金额不会影响您或您现任配偶可能获得的福利金额。

### 您子女的福利

当您符合社会保障残疾福利的资格时，您的子女也可能有资格基于您的记录领取福利。您符合条件的子女可以是您的亲生子女、收养子女或继子女。受抚养的孙辈也可能符合资格。

要领取福利，子女必须未婚且符合以下条件之一：

- 未满18岁；或
- 18至19岁，且为全日制学生（不超过12年级）；或
- 年满18岁或以上，且在22岁之前开始有残疾。

通常，福利在子女年满18岁时停止，除非他们残疾。但是，如果子女在18岁时仍在中学（或小学）全日制就读，福利将持续到子女毕业或年满19岁后两个月，以先到者为准。

- 关于您可能在他人的记录上符合条件的潜在福利；

## 遗属福利

使用我们的遗属规划器了解：

- 如果您去世，您的家庭成员如何得到保障，或

- 您如何作为他人社会保障记录上的遗属而有资格获得保障。

这项保障对于有子女的年轻家庭尤为重要。即使是非常年轻的工人也可能享有这项保障。了解更多 关于工作积分及其如何影响遗属福利的信息。

## 配偶福利

即使您从未在社会保障制度下工作过，如果您符合以下身份，您仍可能有资格获得福利：

- 退休工人的配偶或离婚配偶；

- 残疾工人的配偶或离婚配偶；或

- 已故工人的遗孀/鳏夫或未再婚的离婚配偶。

## 在线工具

使用我们的福利计算器之一来帮助您规划：

- 使用您的个人我的社会保障账户在线获取信息，以核实您的收入记录是否正确，并获得您未来 退休、残疾和遗属福利的估算。

- 如果您已有足够的社会保障积分以符合福利资格，您可以使用我们的退休估算器获得个性化的 即时退休福利估算。您可以输入不同的日期和年龄，以确定最适合您的退休时间。

- 如果您需要遗属或残疾福利的估算，或者您尚未积累足够的社会保障积分以符合福利资格，请 使用我们的福利计算器之一来估算您未来的退休、残疾和遗属福利。"}, {"chunk_id": "Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Family | Social Security Administration#1_0::c0000", "text": "# 福利规划器：退休 | 您的家庭福利 | 社会保障管理局

## 福利规划器：退休

### 您的家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

如果他们符合资格，您的配偶或子女每月可能收到高达您全额退休福利金额一半的付款。这些付款不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，您的家庭可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

支付给您配偶的福利不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，他们可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您的子女之一**也符合资格**领取福利，我们能够支付给您家庭的金额是有限制的。总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也符合资格的家庭成员人数。

总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家庭能够收到的总金额约为您全额退休福利的150%至180%。

如果您有一位符合福利资格的前配偶，这不会影响您或您的家庭可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一起申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 您的配偶的福利

即使您的配偶从未在社会保障制度下工作过，只要他们年满62岁，并且您正在领取或有资格领取退休或残疾福利，他们也可能获得福利。您的配偶在65岁时也有资格加入Medicare。

### 我的配偶将收到多少？

如果您的配偶根据他们自己的记录有资格领取福利，我们将首先支付该金额。如果根据您的记录的福利更高，他们将根据您的记录获得额外金额，以便福利组合等于该更高金额。

您配偶的福利不包括您可能获得的任何延迟退休积分。

如果他们开始领取福利：

- 在62岁至其全额退休年龄之间，金额将根据距离其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。如果您的配偶未达到全额退休年龄并且：
  - 在领取福利期间工作，他们的福利可能会受到退休收入测试的影响。
  - 也根据他们自己的记录符合资格，他们的申请将包括两种福利。
- 在其全额退休年龄时，配偶的福利不能超过您全额退休金额的一半。"}, {"chunk_id": "Explore The Benefits You May Be Due#1_0::c0000", "text": "[探索您可能有权获得的福利 > 您或您的家人可能有资格获得增加的福利 > 联系社会保障局]
我们的使命是提供满足公众不断变化需求的社会保障服务。

福利领取者的状况在申请或符合福利资格后发生变化并不罕见。如果您或您的家人领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI），某些生活变化可能会影响您获得联邦福利增加的资格。例如，如果您的配偶或前配偶去世，您可能有资格获得更高的社会保障福利。

要了解您或您的家人是否可能基于他人的工作记录而有资格获得福利，或基于您自己的工作记录获得更高的福利，请参阅社会保障网站上的福利信息。您还可以使用福利资格筛选工具（BEST）来了解您是否可以获得社会保障管理局管理的福利。根据您对问题的回答，该工具将列出您可能有资格获得的福利，并告诉您有关如何符合资格和申请的更多信息。

以下问题和答案涉及一些可能增加您福利的生活变化。

您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

如果您的配偶或前配偶已去世，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的遗属福利。即使您已经在领取基于另一位配偶的遗属福利，前配偶的去世也可能使您有资格获得更高的遗属福利。

您是否正在领取基于您自己工作记录的医疗保险福利，其中包括至少10年您缴纳社会保障税的收入？

如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

您那个曾帮助抚养您的成年子女是否已去世？

如果您的子女有足够的工作积分，并且曾提供您至少一半的生活费，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的父母福利。

您是否正在领取基于您配偶工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的退休福利。

您是否正在领取基于您父母工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的残疾福利。

您目前是否未婚，但曾结婚10年或以上？

如果您年满62岁且未婚，并且那段婚姻持续了10年或以上，您可能有资格基于前配偶的工作记录获得福利。

您的子女是否有资格根据您配偶的工作情况领取社会保障子女福利？

如果您照顾的子女未满16岁或在22岁之前残疾，您可能有资格领取配偶福利。

您目前是否正在领取退休或残疾福利，并且照顾的子女未满18岁或残疾？

您的子女可能根据您的工作情况有资格领取福利。

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI）或社会保障福利，并且有服兵役经历？

如果您曾在美国军队服役，您可能有资格通过退伍军人管理局领取福利。请访问此链接了解更多信息：http://www.va.gov/

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI），并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利？

如果您未婚且未满18岁或在22岁之前残疾，并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利，您可能有资格根据您父母的工作情况领取子女福利。

您的收入是否下降或您是否经历了财务资源的损失？

您可能能够通过补充保障收入计划获得额外收入，该计划帮助收入和财务资源有限的老年人和残疾人。

## 福利规划器：家庭福利

当您开始领取残疾福利时，您的某些家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。福利可以支付给您的：

- 配偶；
- 离婚配偶；
- 子女；
- 残疾子女；以及
- 22岁前残疾的成年子女。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员申请福利，我们将要求提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

如果您的配偶申请福利，我们也可能要求提供婚姻证明以及之前婚姻的日期（如适用）。

### 最高家庭金额

每位家庭成员每月可能有资格领取高达您残疾福利金额50%的福利。但是，我们可以支付给您家庭的金额有限制。

总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也有资格领取福利的家庭成员人数。总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家庭可以领取的总金额在您残疾福利的150%到180%之间。

如果您的账户上应支付的福利总和大于家庭限额，则支付给家庭成员的福利将按比例减少。您的福利不会受到影响。

如果您有一位符合福利资格的离婚配偶，这不会影响您或您的家庭可能领取的福利金额。

### 您配偶的福利

当您的配偶有资格领取福利时：

- 年满62岁或以上，除非他或她根据其收入记录领取更高的社会保障福利。配偶福利金额将根据距离其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。

- 任何年龄，如果他或她在照顾您未满16岁或残疾的子女。

您的配偶将领取这些福利，直到子女年满16岁。届时，子女的福利继续，但您配偶的福利停止，除非他或她年龄足够领取退休福利（62岁或以上）或作为遗孀或鳏夫领取遗属福利（60岁）。

### 如果您的配偶也在社会保障下工作过

如果您的配偶有资格根据其自己的记录领取退休福利，我们将始终首先支付该金额。但是，如果根据您的记录应支付的配偶福利金额更高，他或她将获得等于该更高金额的福利组合。

如果您的配偶也将根据未纳入社会保障的工作（如政府或外国工作）领取养老金，那么他或她基于您记录获得的社会保障福利可能会受到影响。

### 您离婚配偶的福利

如果您已离婚，即使您再婚，您的前配偶也可能有资格基于您的记录获得福利。

（如果您的前配偶也将根据未纳入社会保障的工作（如政府或外国工作）领取养老金，那么他或她基于您记录获得的社会保障福利可能会受到影响。）

要基于您的记录获得资格，您的前配偶必须：

- 与您结婚至少10年；
- 年满62岁；
- 未婚；且
- 没有资格基于其自身或其他人的社会保障记录获得同等或更高的福利。

支付给您离婚配偶的福利金额不会影响您或您现任配偶可能获得的福利金额。

### 您子女的福利

当您符合社会保障残疾福利的资格时，您的子女也可能有资格基于您的记录领取福利。您符合条件的子女可以是您的亲生子女、收养子女或继子女。受抚养的孙辈也可能符合资格。

要领取福利，子女必须未婚且符合以下条件之一：

- 未满18岁；或
- 18至19岁，且为全日制学生（不超过12年级）；或
- 年满18岁或以上，且在22岁之前开始有残疾。

通常，福利在子女年满18岁时停止，除非他们残疾。但是，如果子女在18岁时仍在中学（或小学）全日制就读，福利将持续到子女毕业或年满19岁后两个月，以先到者为准。

了解更多关于残疾子女福利的信息。

- 残疾福利
- 子女福利

一旦DIU收到可接受的文件，您就可以在线完成恢复申请。
- 如果您在25年内有两次或以上酒驾/毒驾定罪，您必须在最终审查之日起一年内完成酒精评估和/或治疗。您的提供者必须通过电子方式通知DMV您已成功完成。您提交的纸质证明将不被接受。您可以通过访问NY State Office of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Services (OASAS)网站 www.oasas.ny.gov [3] 查找纽约州内可接受的评估和治疗提供者。点击右侧顶部框中的“FIND A PROVIDER”链接。点击项目类型：“Providers of Clinical Screening and Assessment Services for Impaired Driving Offender”以搜索您所在地区经OASAS批准的临床服务提供者列表。您可以按县、城市或邮政编码搜索批准的提供者。如果您无法访问互联网，请拨打OASAS HOPE热线1-877-846-7369。该免费热线全天24小时、每周7天运营。选择酒精或药物评估/治疗提供者时，请注意提供者必须出现在列表中。除非提供者已获得OASAS批准，否则将不被接受。要进入此批准列表，提供者必须联系OASAS，电话1-800-482-9564获取说明。对于纽约州以外的服务，提供者必须位于Substance Abuse & Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA)网站 https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4] 的批准提供者列表中。提供者将需要表格DS-449 Alcohol and Drug Abuse Rehabilitation Program Summary。他们可以联系Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228或传真(518) 473-8229获取此表格。

- 如果您目前因未支付子女抚养费而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系当地子女抚养费征收单位进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除/移除子女抚养费暂停，除非Office of Temporary Disability (OTDA)指示这样做。一旦OTDA电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。
- 如果您目前因未缴纳纽约州税款而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系NY State Department of Tax and Finance (DTF) [6] 或致电(518) 862-6000进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除欠税暂停，除非DTF指示这样做。一旦DTF电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。

- 如果您有未处理的交通罚单或欠法院罚款，您必须联系记录法院。未处理的罚单需要处理，所有罚款需要在您申请驾照前支付。一旦法院通知DMV罚单已处理，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。

注意：任何额外的驾驶违规定罪或其他添加到您驾驶记录的事件可能使您不符合批准资格或延迟批准过程。"}, {"chunk_id": "Conditional and restricted use licenses#3_0::c0000", "text": "# Conditional 和 Restricted Use 许可证

你必须亲自到 DMV 办公室申请 conditional 或 restricted use 许可证。你可以在大多数（但不是所有）Motor Vehicles 办公室办理。请联系离你最近的办公室 [1] 以了解在哪里申请。

### Conditional

DMV 可以向符合条件的驾驶员签发 conditional license，前提是该驾驶员的 NY State 驾照因酒精或毒品相关的违规行为而被吊销或撤销。该驾驶员必须参加由 DMV 批准的 Impaired Driver Program (IDP) [2]（以前称为 Drinking Driving Program (DDP)）。

### Restricted use

DMV 可以向符合条件且其驾照因非酒精或毒品相关的违规或事故，或因某些毒品相关违规而被吊销或撤销的驾驶员签发 restricted use license。

### 来自其他州的驾驶员

如果你持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，并且满足其他要求，你可以获得在 NY State 驾驶的 conditional driving privilege 或 restricted driving privilege。其条件或限制与持有 NY State 驾驶执照的驾驶员相同。"}, {"chunk_id": "Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3_0::c0003", "text": "[扣分与保险减免计划 > 关于……的问答 > DMV 积分制度摘要]

某些驾照的吊销和撤销是强制性的，不取决于积分。这些情况包括18个月内的三次超速违章，以及涉及酒精或药物的定罪。

在安装点火联锁装置后，您需要携带来自Driver Improvement的批准包中的以下所有物品到任何当地机动车办公室申请许可证/执照：

问题驾驶员限制和点火联锁装置是根据《机动车管理局专员条例》第3.2(4)(c)条的授权而要求的。您需要在自己拥有或操作的所有机动车上安装并维护点火联锁装置，为期五年。在重新获得驾照后，除就业时间内且仅当您的职业要求操作机动车时，您不得驾驶任何未安装联锁装置的车辆。您的雇主必须提供一份签署的公司信笺文件，说明他们知晓点火联锁限制。该信函还必须允许您在没有该装置的情况下为商业目的操作车辆。在操作雇主的车辆时，您必须随身携带此文件。

具有A2问题驾驶员限制的驾驶员只能在以下限制下操作车辆：

- 往返于工作或教育场所；在工作或教育期间，如有需要。如果您因工作而驾驶，您的雇主必须提供一份签署的公司信笺文件，说明他们知晓点火联锁限制。该信函还必须允许您在没有该装置的情况下为商业目的操作车辆。在操作雇主的车辆时，您必须随身携带此文件。
- 往返于为您或您的家庭成员进行必要医疗治疗的医疗预约。您可能需要提供持照医疗从业者的书面声明，以验证此类出行。
- 往返于DMV办公室，以修改带有问题驾驶员限制的驾驶执照。
- 往返于一个地方，包括学校，孩子定期在那里得到照顾，并且这对于持有人维持其就业是必要的。
- 在认可的学校、学院或大学或州批准的职业技术培训机构注册。

这些限制将从文件签发之日起持续五年。如果您有任何违规/定罪，批准可能会被撤销，并且可能不会对您恢复纽约州驾驶执照的任何未来请求给予有利考虑。

## 芥子气或路易氏剂暴露

如果您曾接触过芥子气（也称为硫芥子气、伊珀里特或氮芥子气）或路易氏剂（一种含有砷毒物的 天然化合物），您可能患有某些相关的长期疾病。了解您是否有资格获得残疾补偿或福利。

我能从退伍军人事务部获得残疾福利吗？

如果您患有被认为是由接触芥子气或路易氏剂引起的残疾，并且您的军事记录显示您曾接触过芥子 气或路易氏剂，您可能可以获得残疾福利。

如果您曾在陆军服役并在以下地点服役：

- 巴拿马运河区圣何塞岛

如果您曾在海军服役并在以下地点服役：

您需要提交残疾补偿申请。

了解如何提交残疾补偿申请

如果您对与芥子气暴露相关的福利有疑问，您可以通过电子邮件联系我们。

发送电子邮件至 mustardgas@vba.va.gov

获取提交申请的帮助

如果我自愿参加涉及化学和生物测试的研究，我能获得福利吗？

多达60,000名退伍军人自愿参加了美国生物和化学项目的医学研究。如果您参与了这项研究，如果 您满足以下两项要求，您可以通过美国陆军获得医疗护理。

以下两项必须均为真实情况。您：

- 在1942年至1975年间自愿参加涉及化学和生物测试的研究，并且

- 有直接由参与这些测试造成的伤害或疾病

如果您有疑问或需要获得医疗护理的帮助：

- 访问美国陆军网页，或

- 致电800-984-8523

### 我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

如果你患有被认为是由服役期间接触环境危害（可能包括接触以下物质）引起的疾病或其他状况，你可能可以获得残疾福利：

- 伊拉克摩苏尔附近 Mishraq 国家硫磺矿的大型硫磺火灾
- 伊拉克巴士拉 Qarmat Ali 水处理厂的六价铬

# Exposure to hazardous chemicals and materials

Find out if you can get disability compensation (monthly payments) and other benefits for illnesses or other conditions, like the ones listed below. These are illnesses and conditions we believe may be caused by contact with harmful chemicals or other hazardous materials while serving in the military.

### Medical care for volunteers involved in chemical and biological testing

As many as 60,000 Veterans volunteered for medical research for the U.S. biological and chemical programs between 1942 and 1975. You can get medical care through the U.S. Army if you volunteered for this research and have an injury or illness directly caused by your participation.

If you have questions or need help getting medical care:

- Visit the U.S. Army web page, or
- Call 800-984-8523

-

#### Agent Orange

If you served in the Republic of Vietnam or in or near the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) during the Vietnam Era or in certain related jobs you may have had contact with Agent Orange, an herbicide used to clear plants and trees during the war.

-

#### Asbestos

If you worked in certain military jobs, you may have had contact with asbestos (toxic fibers once used in many buildings and products).

-

#### Birth defects like spina bifida

If you served in the Republic of Vietnam, in Thailand, or in or near the DMZ during the Vietnam Era and your child has spina bifida or certain other birth defects your child may be eligible for disability benefits.

-

#### Contact with mustard gas or lewisite

If you served at the German bombing of Bari, Italy, in World War II or worked in certain other jobs, you may have had contact with mustard gas.

-

#### Contaminated drinking water at Camp Lejeune

If you served at Camp Lejeune or MCAS New River between August 1953 and December 1987, you may be at risk for certain illnesses believed to be caused by contaminants found in the drinking water during that time.

-

#### Gulf War Illness

If you served in the Southwest Asia theater of operations, you may be at risk of certain illnesses or other conditions linked to this region.

-

#### Gulf War Illness in Afghanistan

If you served in Afghanistan, you may be at risk of certain illnesses or other conditions linked to this region.

-

#### Project 112/SHAD

If you were part warfare testing for Projects 112 or Shipboard Hazard and Defense (SHAD) from 1962 to 1974, you may be at risk of illnesses believed to be caused by chemical testing.

-

#### Radiation exposure

If you served in the post-WWII occupation of Hiroshima or Nagasaki, were imprisoned in Japan, worked with or near nuclear weapons testing, or served at a gaseous diffusion plant or in certain other jobs, you may be at risk for illnesses believed to be caused by radiation.

-

#### Specific environmental hazards

If you served in Iraq, Afghanistan, Djibouti, or near Atsugi, Japan, you may have had contact with toxic chemicals in the air, water, or soil.

# Agent Orange exposure from C-123 aircraft

If you flew on or worked with C-123 aircraft in Vietnam or other locations, you may have had contact with Agent Orange. The U.S. military used this herbicide to clear trees and plants during the Vietnam War. C-123 aircraft sprayed Agent Orange during the war, and the planes still had traces of the chemical in them afterward while they were being used, up until 1986. Find out if you can get disability compensation and other benefits for illnesses we believe are caused by contact with Agent Orange.

### Can I get disability benefits from VA?

#### For active-duty service members

You may be able to get disability benefits if the below descriptions are true for you.

This must be true:

- You have an illness we believe is caused by contact with Agent Orange (called a presumptive disease)

And both of these must also be true:

- You served in a regular Air Force unit location where a C-123 aircraft with traces of Agent Orange was assigned, and
- Your flight, ground, or medical duties put you in regular and repeated contact with C-123 aircraft that had traces of Agent Orange

If you have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange, you won t need to show the problem started during or got worse because of your military service. This is because we believe that certain diseases are the result of exposure to herbicides. We refer to these as "presumptive diseases."Review our list of diseases related to Agent Orange

Check our list of military units and Air Force specialty codes to see if your unit had contact with affected C-123 aircraft. View the list of codes (PDF)

#### For Reservists

You may be able to get disability benefits if the below descriptions are true for you.

Both of these must be true:

- You have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange (called a presumptive disease), and
- You were assigned to flight, ground, or medical crew duties at one of the below locations

You must have been assigned to one of these locations:

- Lockbourne/Rickenbacker Air Force Base in Ohio, 1969-1986 (906th and 907th Tactical Air Groups or 355th and 356th Tactical Airlift Squadrons), or
- Westover Air Force Base in Massachusetts, 1972-1982 (731st Tactical Air Squadron and 74th Aeromedical Evacuation Squadron, or 901st Organizational Maintenance Squadron), or
- Pittsburgh International Airport in Pennsylvania, 1972-1982 (758th Airlift Squadron)

If you have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange, you won t need to show the problem started during or got worse because of your military service. This is because we believe that certain diseases are the result of exposure to herbicides. We refer to these as "presumptive diseases."Review our list of diseases related to Agent Orange

Check our list of military units and Air Force specialty codes to see if your unit had contact with affected C-123 aircraft. View the list of codes (PDF)

## What kind of disability benefits can I get?

- Health care
- Compensation (payments)

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation. When you file, you ll have to show that you had exposure to Agent Orange while serving in the military.

You can upload supporting documents along with your online application, including:

- Discharge or separation papers (DD214 or other separation documents)
- USAF Form 2096 (unit where you were assigned at the time of the training action)
- USAF Form 5 (aircraft flight duties)
- USAF Form 781 (aircraft maintenance duties)
- Dependency records (marriage certificate and children s birth certificates)
- Medical evidence (like a doctor s report or medical test results)

Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation

## What if I need help filing my claim?

- Call the C-123 hotline at 800-749-8387, or
- Email the St. Paul regional benefit office

You can get help from a trained professional trusted to help with VA-related claims. Get help filing your claim

Want to know more about C-123 aircraft Agent Orange claims? Download our C-123 Aircraft Agent Orange Exposure claims fact sheet (PDF)

查看弗吉尼亚州残疾福利资格标准，以确定您是否有资格因现役军事服务导致或加重的疾病或伤害获得残疾补偿。补偿可能包括经济支持和其他福利，如医疗保健。

### 我是否有资格获得弗吉尼亚州残疾补偿？

如果您目前患有影响身体或心理的疾病或伤害（称为病症），并且满足以下至少一项要求，您可能能够获得弗吉尼亚州残疾福利或补偿。

以下两项必须均为真。您：

- 在现役、现役训练或非现役训练期间服役，并且
- 因服役相关病症获得残疾评级

- 有与现役服务相关的残疾，但在服役结束后才显现（称为服役后残疾索赔）

- 出院后一年内出现的慢性（长期）疾病，或
- 因接触污染物（有毒化学品）或其他危险材料引起的疾病，或

### 我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

如果你满足以下列出的两项要求，你可能能够获得残疾福利。

以下两项都必须为真：

- 你至少有 1 项服务连接性残疾评级为 60% 或以上致残，或有 2 项或以上服务连接性残疾，其中至少 1 项评级为 40% 或以上致残，且合并评级为 70% 或以上，并且
- 由于你的服务连接性残疾，你无法维持一份能经济上支持你的稳定工作（称为 substantially gainful employment）。零工（marginal employment）不算。

注意：在某些情况下，例如，如果你需要经常住院，你可能在较低的残疾评级下符合条件。

Veterans

# Exposure to hazardous chemicals and materials

Find out if you can get disability compensation (monthly payments) and other benefits for illnesses or other conditions, like the ones listed below. These are illnesses and conditions we believe may be caused by contact with harmful chemicals or other hazardous materials while serving in the military.

### Medical care for volunteers involved in chemical and biological testing

As many as 60,000 Veterans volunteered for medical research for the U.S. biological and chemical programs between 1942 and 1975. You can get medical care through the U.S. Army if you volunteered for this research and have an injury or illness directly caused by your participation.

If you have questions or need help getting medical care:

- Visit the U.S. Army web page, or
- Call 800-984-8523

-

#### Agent Orange

If you served in the Republic of Vietnam or in or near the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) during the Vietnam Era or in certain related jobs you may have had contact with Agent Orange, an herbicide used to clear plants and trees during the war.

-

#### Asbestos

If you worked in certain military jobs, you may have had contact with asbestos (toxic fibers once used in many buildings and products).

-

#### Birth defects like spina bifida

If you served in the Republic of Vietnam, in Thailand, or in or near the DMZ during the Vietnam Era and your child has spina bifida or certain other birth defects your child may be eligible for disability benefits.

-

#### Contact with mustard gas or lewisite

If you served at the German bombing of Bari, Italy, in World War II or worked in certain other jobs, you may have had contact with mustard gas.

-

#### Contaminated drinking water at Camp Lejeune

If you served at Camp Lejeune or MCAS New River between August 1953 and December 1987, you may be at risk for certain illnesses believed to be caused by contaminants found in the drinking water during that time.

-

#### Gulf War Illness

If you served in the Southwest Asia theater of operations, you may be at risk of certain illnesses or other conditions linked to this region.

-

#### Gulf War Illness in Afghanistan

If you served in Afghanistan, you may be at risk of certain illnesses or other conditions linked to this region.

-

#### Project 112/SHAD

If you were part warfare testing for Projects 112 or Shipboard Hazard and Defense (SHAD) from 1962 to 1974, you may be at risk of illnesses believed to be caused by chemical testing.

-

#### Radiation exposure

If you served in the post-WWII occupation of Hiroshima or Nagasaki, were imprisoned in Japan, worked with or near nuclear weapons testing, or served at a gaseous diffusion plant or in certain other jobs, you may be at risk for illnesses believed to be caused by radiation.

-

#### Specific environmental hazards

If you served in Iraq, Afghanistan, Djibouti, or near Atsugi, Japan, you may have had contact with toxic chemicals in the air, water, or soil.

# Agent Orange exposure from C-123 aircraft

If you flew on or worked with C-123 aircraft in Vietnam or other locations, you may have had contact with Agent Orange. The U.S. military used this herbicide to clear trees and plants during the Vietnam War. C-123 aircraft sprayed Agent Orange during the war, and the planes still had traces of the chemical in them afterward while they were being used, up until 1986. Find out if you can get disability compensation and other benefits for illnesses we believe are caused by contact with Agent Orange.

### Can I get disability benefits from VA?

#### For active-duty service members

You may be able to get disability benefits if the below descriptions are true for you.

This must be true:

- You have an illness we believe is caused by contact with Agent Orange (called a presumptive disease)

And both of these must also be true:

- You served in a regular Air Force unit location where a C-123 aircraft with traces of Agent Orange was assigned, and
- Your flight, ground, or medical duties put you in regular and repeated contact with C-123 aircraft that had traces of Agent Orange

If you have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange, you won t need to show the problem started during or got worse because of your military service. This is because we believe that certain diseases are the result of exposure to herbicides. We refer to these as "presumptive diseases."Review our list of diseases related to Agent Orange

Check our list of military units and Air Force specialty codes to see if your unit had contact with affected C-123 aircraft. View the list of codes (PDF)

#### For Reservists

You may be able to get disability benefits if the below descriptions are true for you.

Both of these must be true:

- You have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange (called a presumptive disease), and
- You were assigned to flight, ground, or medical crew duties at one of the below locations

You must have been assigned to one of these locations:

- Lockbourne/Rickenbacker Air Force Base in Ohio, 1969-1986 (906th and 907th Tactical Air Groups or 355th and 356th Tactical Airlift Squadrons), or
- Westover Air Force Base in Massachusetts, 1972-1982 (731st Tactical Air Squadron and 74th Aeromedical Evacuation Squadron, or 901st Organizational Maintenance Squadron), or
- Pittsburgh International Airport in Pennsylvania, 1972-1982 (758th Airlift Squadron)

If you have an illness we believe is caused by Agent Orange, you won t need to show the problem started during or got worse because of your military service. This is because we believe that certain diseases are the result of exposure to herbicides. We refer to these as "presumptive diseases."Review our list of diseases related to Agent Orange

Check our list of military units and Air Force specialty codes to see if your unit had contact with affected C-123 aircraft. View the list of codes (PDF)

## What kind of disability benefits can I get?

- Health care
- Compensation (payments)

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to file a claim for disability compensation. When you file, you ll have to show that you had exposure to Agent Orange while serving in the military.

You can upload supporting documents along with your online application, including:

- Discharge or separation papers (DD214 or other separation documents)
- USAF Form 2096 (unit where you were assigned at the time of the training action)
- USAF Form 5 (aircraft flight duties)
- USAF Form 781 (aircraft maintenance duties)
- Dependency records (marriage certificate and children s birth certificates)
- Medical evidence (like a doctor s report or medical test results)

Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation

## What if I need help filing my claim?

- Call the C-123 hotline at 800-749-8387, or
- Email the St. Paul regional benefit office

You can get help from a trained professional trusted to help with VA-related claims. Get help filing your claim

### Get more information

Want to know more about C-123 aircraft Agent Orange claims? Download our C-123 Aircraft Agent Orange Exposure claims fact sheet (PDF)

# 弗吉尼亚州残疾福利资格

查看弗吉尼亚州残疾福利资格标准，以确定您是否有资格因现役军事服务导致或加重的疾病或伤害获得残疾补偿。补偿可能包括经济支持和其他福利，如医疗保健。

### 我是否有资格获得弗吉尼亚州残疾补偿？

如果您目前患有影响身体或心理的疾病或伤害（称为病症），并且满足以下至少一项要求，您可能能够获得弗吉尼亚州残疾福利或补偿。

以下两项必须均为真。您：

- 在现役、现役训练或非现役训练期间服役，并且
- 因服役相关病症获得残疾评级

- 在军队服役期间生病或受伤，并且可以将此病症与您的疾病或伤害联系起来（称为服役期间残疾索赔），或
- 在入伍前患有疾病或伤害，而服役使其恶化（称为服役前残疾索赔），或
- 有与现役服务相关的残疾，但在服役结束后才显现（称为服役后残疾索赔）

- 出院后一年内出现的慢性（长期）疾病，或
- 因接触污染物（有毒化学品）或其他危险材料引起的疾病，或

# VA Individual Unemployability 如果你无法工作

如果你因与军队服役相关的残疾（服务连接性残疾）而无法工作，你可能符合所谓的 Individual Unemployability 的条件。这意味着你可能能够获得与拥有 100% 残疾评级的 Veteran 相同水平的残疾补偿或福利。

### 我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

如果你满足以下列出的两项要求，你可能能够获得残疾福利。

以下两项都必须为真：

- 你至少有 1 项服务连接性残疾评级为 60% 或以上致残，或有 2 项或以上服务连接性残疾，其中至少 1 项评级为 40% 或以上致残，且合并评级为 70% 或以上，并且
- 由于你的服务连接性残疾，你无法维持一份能经济上支持你的稳定工作（称为 substantially gainful employment）。零工（marginal employment）不算。

注意：在某些情况下，例如，如果你需要经常住院，你可能在较低的残疾评级下符合条件。

### 谁受保障？

Veterans

## 我能获得哪些类型的福利？

- 医疗保健
- 补偿（付款）

## 我如何获得这些福利？

你需要提交残疾补偿申请。当你提交时，你需要提供证据（支持性文件，如医生报告或医学检测结果），证明你的残疾使你无法维持稳定工作。我们还会审查你的工作和教育历史。示例：一位 Veteran 有服务连接性心脏病，残疾评级为 60%。她直到去年仍能工作，当时她开始在做任何体力活动（如走路或搬箱子）时出现胸痛。她的医生告诉她尽快退休。她提交了更多残疾补偿的申请。我们审查了她的工作和教育历史，并同意她因服务连接性残疾而 individual unemployable。因此，我们将她的残疾补偿提高到与 100% 残疾 Veteran 相同的水平。

了解如何提交残疾补偿申请

当你提交残疾申请时，你还需要填写以下针对 Individual Unemployability 福利的额外表格：

- Veteran 的基于不可就业性的增加补偿申请（VA Form 21-8940）下载 VA Form 21-8940 (PDF) 和
- 与残疾福利申请相关的就业信息请求（VA Form 21-4192）下载 VA Form 21-4192 (PDF)

你需要继续满足基本资格标准，取得令人满意的学业进步，并每年填写FAFSA表格。

一旦你填写了联邦学生援助免费申请（FAFSA）表格，并获得了助学金、贷款或勤工助学资金来帮助你支付大学或职业学校的费用，请确保你在整个学年及以后的年份中保持资格。

## 继续满足基本资格标准

请记住，允许你获得联邦学生援助的基本资格标准在你接受援助的整个期间都适用，而不仅仅是在你首次填写FAFSA表格并获得援助时。

## 取得令人满意的学业进步

你需要取得令人满意的学业进步才能继续获得联邦学生援助。换句话说，你必须取得足够好的成绩，并完成足够的课程（学分、学时等），以便在你学校可接受的时间范围内，持续朝着成功完成学位或证书的目标前进。

每所学校都有针对经济援助目的的学业进步满意政策；要查看你学校的政策，你可以查看学校网站或咨询经济援助办公室的人员。你学校的政策将告诉你：

- 你需要保持的绩点（或同等标准）；
- 你需要以多快的速度朝着毕业前进（例如，每年结束时你应该成功完成多少学分）；
- 未完成的课程、退课、重修课程、更换专业或从其他学校转学分如何影响你的学业进步满意状态；
- 你的学校多久评估一次你的进步；
- 如果你的学校评估时你未能取得令人满意的学业进步，会发生什么；
- 你是否被允许对学校关于你未取得满意学业进步的决定提出申诉（申诉理由通常包括家庭成员去世、你的疾病或受伤，或其他特殊情况）；以及
- 你如何重新获得联邦学生援助的资格。

# Students with criminal convictions have limited eligibility for federal student aid.

Make sure you understand your status, and don t assume you can t get aid.

Your eligibility for federal student aid can be affected by incarceration and/or the type of conviction you have.

Try This Resource*Federal Student Aid Eligibility for Students Confined in Adult Correctional or Juvenile Justice Facilities* Provides information for incarcerated individuals on federal student aid eligibility.

## If I m incarcerated, can I get federal student aid?

You have limited eligibility for federal student aid.

Once you re released, most eligibility limitations will be removed. In fact, you may apply for aid before you re released so your aid is processed in time for you to start school. However, if your incarceration was for a drug-related offense or if you are subject to an involuntary civil commitment for a sexual offense, your eligibility may be limited.

Even if you are ineligible for federal aid, you should complete the *Free Application for Federal Student Aid* (FAFSA) form, because most schools and states use FAFSA information to award nonfederal aid, and you might be able to get some of those funds.

## If I m on probation or parole, can I get federal student aid?

Yes; if you are on probation or parole or living in a halfway house, you may be eligible for federal student aid. But remember, if you were convicted of a drug-related offense or if you are subject to an involuntary civil commitment for a sexual offense, your eligibility may be limited.

## Is it true that drug convictions might affect my ability to get federal student aid?

Yes; your eligibility might be suspended if the offense occurred while you were receiving federal student aid (grants, loans, or work-study). When you complete the FAFSA form, you will be asked whether you had a drug conviction for an offense that occurred while you were receiving federal student aid. If the answer is yes, you will be provided a worksheet to help you determine whether your conviction affects your eligibility for federal student aid.

If your eligibility for federal student aid has been suspended due to a drug conviction, you can regain eligibility early by successfully completing an approved drug rehabilitation program or by passing two unannounced drug tests administered by an approved drug rehabilitation program. If you regain eligibility during the award year, notify your financial aid office immediately so you can get any aid you re eligible for.

If you are convicted of a drug-related offense after you submit the FAFSA form, you might lose eligibility for federal student aid, and you might be liable for returning any financial aid you received during a period of ineligibility.

## What other convictions might affect my aid?

# 如果你想继续获得联邦学生援助，请确保你保持资格。

你需要继续满足基本资格标准，取得令人满意的学业进步，并每年填写FAFSA表格。

一旦你填写了联邦学生援助免费申请（FAFSA）表格，并获得了助学金、贷款或勤工助学资金来帮助你支付大学或职业学校的费用，请确保你在整个学年及以后的年份中保持资格。

## 继续满足基本资格标准

请记住，允许你获得联邦学生援助的基本资格标准在你接受援助的整个期间都适用，而不仅仅是在你首次填写FAFSA表格并获得援助时。

## 取得令人满意的学业进步

你需要取得令人满意的学业进步才能继续获得联邦学生援助。换句话说，你必须取得足够好的成绩，并完成足够的课程（学分、学时等），以便在你学校可接受的时间范围内，持续朝着成功完成学位或证书的目标前进。

每所学校都有针对经济援助目的的学业进步满意政策；要查看你学校的政策，你可以查看学校网站或咨询经济援助办公室的人员。你学校的政策将告诉你：

- 你需要保持的绩点（或同等标准）；
- 你需要以多快的速度朝着毕业前进（例如，每年结束时你应该成功完成多少学分）；
- 未完成的课程、退课、重修课程、更换专业或从其他学校转学分如何影响你的学业进步满意状态；
- 你的学校多久评估一次你的进步；
- 如果你的学校评估时你未能取得令人满意的学业进步，会发生什么；
- 你是否被允许对学校关于你未取得满意学业进步的决定提出申诉（申诉理由通常包括家庭成员去世、你的疾病或受伤，或其他特殊情况）；以及
- 你如何重新获得联邦学生援助的资格。

许多学校从自己的资金中提供财政援助。

非营利或私人组织
